cards.say: What is the difference between forty-two and twenty-nine? Thirteen. Count up from twenty-nine to thirty, which is one, then to forty-two, which is twelve. One plus twelve equals thirteen.

cards.front: Mina has 38 stickers and gets 24 more. How many now?
cards.back: 62 stickers. 38 + 24 = 62.
cards.say: Mina has thirty-eight stickers and gets twenty-four more. How many now? Sixty-two stickers. Thirty-eight plus twenty-four equals sixty-two.

cards.front: There are 70 books. 26 are lent out. How many are left?
cards.back: 44 books. 70 take away 26 is 44.
cards.say: There are seventy books. Twenty-six are lent out. How many are left? Forty-four books. Seventy take away twenty-six is forty-four.
